clarifications: Each player chooses a mouse and puts it on the start field.
After the youngest player starts, play continues clockwise. Each player rolls and moves on their turn.
The youngest-player instruction selects the initial starter. No separate later-round starter or alternative mode is supplied.
This answer summarizes the German pages of the compact article 51405 manual for two to four players. The standard article 40505 manual is a separate edition.
